page.layout: One page of centred title lines, from top to bottom: author's name, main title in capitals, subtitle, "Libri IV.", "Cum Præfatione" with the editor's name, dedication to the Chancellor (set in three lines with a hyphenated break), a woodcut emblem in the middle, then the imprint, the printer line and the date line at the foot. No running head, no page number, no margin notes.

main_text.l: M. IOH. PHILIPPI PAREI DAV. F.
RVM à GRYN in Weiersberg, &c. Can-

page.notes: Woodcut emblem between the dedication and the imprint: a crown above a column, with a V-shaped ribbon or base and laurel or foliage on both sides. Banners on the ribbons carry a motto. Only fragments are legible: "CONSILI..." on the left, "PIETA..." in the centre and "...ONOR..." on the right. The full motto cannot be read, so the emblem text is marked illegible rather than completed. The date line prints "CIↃ IↃ C X." in the reversed-C form, transcribed as MDCX per the numeral rule. The printed stop after "Typog" is kept as it stands. The Greek ampersand in "& Theologicarum" is the printed ligature form.
